candidate.text: Here's the thing nobody tells you about running a startup. You think the hardest part is building the product. It's not. The hardest part is the moment everything breaks at once. Um, so, like, we were three days from making payroll. And then, our biggest client just disappeared, no call, no email. I was terrified, genuinely terrified, sitting in my car in a parking lot. So what did I do.
